intro.readOnly: A read-only view of the submitted OÜ founding details.
intro.resubmission: Update the founding details below and resubmit to the Business Register. New signing links will be sent to every co-founder.
intro.default: Register a new Estonian private limited company (OÜ). Fill in the company name, at least one board member, the share capital, your own details, and list any co-founders that must sign the Articles of Association before the case goes to the Business Register.

aoa.label: Articles of Association (required)
aoa.hint: PDF, JPEG, or PNG up to 10 MB. The Business Register reviewer and every co-founder reviewing the registration will be able to download this file.
aoa.uploadLabel: Drop your Articles of Association here, or click to choose

residency.hint: Drives the Business Register's auto-approval policy: foreign founders always go to a reviewer; Estonian citizens and e-residents with the minimum share capital can auto-approve.

citizen.label: Estonian citizen
citizen.hint: Lives and works in Estonia under Estonian citizenship.

eResident.label: E-resident
eResident.hint: Holds an Estonian e-Residency digital ID; lives abroad.

foreign.label: Foreign founder
foreign.hint: Neither Estonian citizen nor e-resident — always requires Business Register review.

applicantEmail.label: Your email (required if you list co-founders)

coFounders.hint: Each co-founder gets an email with a link to sign the Articles of Association or reject. Once all co-founders sign, any founder can click "Submit to register" to forward the case to the Business Register. Leave empty if you are the sole founder.

errors.boardMemberRequired: At least one board member is required.
errors.boardMemberIncomplete: Every board member needs first name, last name, and a personal code.
errors.shareCapitalMin: Share capital must be a number >= 2500.
errors.applicantNameRequired: Your first name and last name are required.
errors.applicantAgeRange: Your age must be a whole number between 0 and 130.
errors.aoaRequired: Please upload the Articles of Association.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address, or leave the field blank.
errors.applicantEmailRequiredForFounders: Your own email is required when adding co-founders — we send you a tracking link.
errors.founderEmailInvalid: Co-founder "{{name}}" needs a valid email address.
errors.duplicateFounderEmail: Two co-founders share the email "{{email}}". Each founder needs a unique address.
errors.applicantEmailInFounders: Your own email cannot also appear in the co-founder list — the applicant is already counted as a founder.
